context.data_run_id: agent_run and tool_execution data.run_id must equal context.run_id

generation: Spindle authenticated g3 nonce, expiration and HMAC-SHA256 lease; ordered sequences starting at 1
data: fabrico11y/3 data vocabulary restricted to metric; inherited metric fields and bounds unchanged

labels.type: object mapping decoded string keys to decoded UTF-8 string values
labels.duplicates: reject duplicate decoded keys, including JSON escape aliases
labels.projection: preserve labels as the nested data.labels field; do not flatten keys into sibling fields

custody: preserve original bytes; local receipt differs from canonical receipt

attributes.brief: Decoded key in the nested metric labels object.
attributes.name: fabric.metric.labels.key
attributes.note: This describes each dynamic key in data.labels and is not a flattened wire attribute. Keys are unique after JSON unescaping, are 1 to 64 ASCII bytes, match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*, and exclude producer, generation, sequence, metric_unit, metric_type, reset, context_run_id, version, and labels.

attributes.brief: Decoded UTF-8 string value paired with a metric label key.
attributes.name: fabric.metric.labels.value
attributes.note: Each value is at most 128 decoded UTF-8 bytes; the empty string is valid. Unicode control characters and NUL are rejected.

semantics.brief: Bounded optional labels object for metric-only v5 observations.
semantics.note: The wire field is the nested object data.labels, not a flattened attribute projection. Labels may be omitted or be an empty object. At most eight entries are allowed. Each decoded key is 1 to 64 ASCII bytes and matches [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*. Each decoded UTF-8 value is 0 to 128 bytes, including the empty string; Unicode control characters and NUL are rejected. Duplicate decoded keys, including JSON escape aliases, are rejected. Keys producer, generation, sequence, metric_unit, metric_type, reset, context_run_id, version, and labels are reserved.
